description.narrative: The objective of the HPMP is to reduce the use of the substances controlled under Annex C Group I (HCFCs) of the Montreal Protocol, in order to meet the HCFC consumption freeze obligation in 2013 and the HCFC 10% and 35% reductions obligation in 2015 and 2020 respectively. The second phase aiming to achieve 67.5% reduction in 2025 will be prepared and submitted in 2019.
